content.text:
I fixed the site. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, so I didn't approve or change any baselines.

The last change had broken three values in `site/css/styles.css`:

1. **Faded text:** `--bs-body-color` was `#d6dade`, a near-white grey. I set it back to `#212529`.
2. **Narrow desktop layout:** at 1200px and wider, `.container` had `max-width: 570px`. That squeezed the navbar and wrapped the heading onto two lines. I set it back to `1140px`.
3. **Overlapping nav links:** `.dropdown` (and the related dropdown classes) had `position: absolute`. That pulled the "Dropdown" item out of the layout, so it overlapped "Home" and "Link". I set it back to `position: relative`.

STATUS: DONE
